title: GENOME: A GENeric methodology for Ontological Modelling of Epics
reasoning: The paper focuses on the ontological modelling of epics, specifically citing religious and mythological works like the Mahabharata (Hindu) and Mahavamsa (Buddhist) as case studies. It includes a benchmarking component where the ontology is evaluated against 'Competency Questions' related to religious and mythological characters and events.
